titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Miejsce zamieszkania — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Home & Living — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Miejsce zamieszkania: typy domów, pomieszczenia, wyposażenie, okolica. Listy do wklejenia w gry LingoSpark.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Home module: house types, rooms, furniture, neighbourhood. Paste into LingoSpark games.

items.definitionEn: a house that is not joined to another house
items.example: They live in a detached house with a garden on both sides.

items.definitionEn: a house joined to one other house by a shared wall
items.example: A semi-detached house is cheaper than a fully detached one.

items.definitionEn: a tall building with many apartments
items.example: We live on the fifth floor of a block of flats.

items.definitionEn: a small house, often in the countryside
items.example: Grandma's cottage has a fireplace and a tiny kitchen.

items.definitionEn: the room or space under the roof
items.example: Old toys are stored in the attic.

items.definitionEn: a room below the ground floor
items.example: The washing machine is in the basement.

items.definitionEn: a pipe that takes smoke from a fire out of the house
items.example: Smoke was coming from the chimney.

items.definitionEn: a barrier around a garden or field
items.example: The dog cannot jump over the wooden fence.

items.definitionEn: a door in a fence or wall that you can open
items.example: Please close the gate so the cat does not run out.

items.definitionEn: a short private road from the street to a house
items.example: Dad parks the car on the driveway.

items.definitionEn: a tall cupboard for hanging clothes
items.example: Hang your coat in the wardrobe.

items.definitionEn: a piece of furniture with drawers for clothes
items.example: Socks are in the top drawer of the chest of drawers.

items.definitionEn: a bowl with taps where you wash things
items.example: Leave the dirty plates in the sink.

items.definitionEn: the control that water comes out of
items.example: Do not leave the tap running while you brush your teeth.

items.definitionEn: a machine that washes plates and cups
items.example: Load the dishwasher after dinner.

items.definitionEn: a system that heats all the rooms from one place
items.example: Turn the central heating down if the room is too hot.

items.definitionEn: a person who lives next to you or nearby
items.example: Our neighbour waters the plants when we go away.

items.definitionEn: the areas at the edge of a town or city
items.example: They bought a flat on the outskirts because it was quieter.

items.definitionEn: the middle part of a city, with shops and offices
items.example: The cinema is in the city centre.

items.definitionEn: land that is not a town, with fields and villages
items.example: I prefer the countryside to noisy streets.

items.definitionEn: money paid to live in a house you do not own; to pay for this
items.example: Students often rent a room near the university.

items.definitionEn: the person who owns the house you rent
items.example: Call the landlord if the heating does not work.

items.definitionEn: having a lot of room inside
items.example: The kitchen is spacious enough for a big table.

items.definitionEn: too small and uncomfortable
items.example: Four people in one cramped bedroom is not ideal.

items.definitionEn: warm, comfortable and pleasant
items.example: The living room looks cosy with the lamp on.

items.definitionEn: already having beds, tables and other furniture
items.example: We rented a fully furnished flat for the summer.

items.definitionEn: to leave one home and go to live in another
items.example: We will move house in August.

items.definitionEn: to clean and tidy the home
items.example: Everyone should help do the housework on Saturday.

items.definitionEn: a machine that sucks up dirt from the floor
items.example: The vacuum cleaner is in the cupboard under the stairs.

items.definitionEn: cloth that covers a window
items.example: Close the curtains before you watch the film.

items.definitionEn: a thick covering on the floor
items.example: Do not spill juice on the new carpet.

items.definitionEn: a platform on the outside of a building that you can stand on
items.example: We grow herbs in pots on the balcony.

items.definitionEn: on a lower floor of the house
items.example: The bathroom downstairs is for guests.

items.definitionEn: on a higher floor of the house
items.example: The children's rooms are upstairs.

items.definitionEn: a residential area outside the city centre
items.example: The suburb has a park and a small supermarket.

items.definitionEn: the space just inside the front door
items.example: Leave your shoes in the hall.
